text: Optical loss un-squeezes light, with an asymptotic ceiling S_max = -10*log10(1 - eta). Roughly how much total loss caps achievable squeezing at about 13 dB?
choices: Loss has no effect on squeezing
explanation: The book states 5% loss caps squeezing at 13 dB (and the 15 dB record required total loss below ~2.5%), because vacuum admitted by loss refills the squeezed quadrature. Larger losses (25%, 50%) would cap squeezing far lower; loss is in fact the dominant limitation, so choice 3 is wrong.
